draft_text: Wrenfold's advantage over Fennick-Base may extend to customer-service domains not seen in training.
rationale: The package evaluates only Banking and Travel unseen test sets (T1.r1, T1.r2), both trained domains. No other domain was evaluated, so the claim about generalization to unseen customer-service domains has no support. The hedged "may" does not rescue it; no evidence bears on other domains.
